surface: memory admission, retrieval, deletion, consolidation, and transitions

findings.title: the retention pass has no production caller, so the flow's delete-to-purge bound is never enforced
findings.recommendation: Invoke the existing MemoryStore#purge_expired pass from the tamoz-agent maintenance/sweep seam using the worker clock and retain its receipt; do not add a second purge implementation.
findings.disposition: accepted open major boundary finding; F19-DEL-01 is carried for the component symptom and corrected mechanism

probes.claim: delete-time receipt reports removal while the deleted version and plaintext remain
the real retention pass removes versions, heads, and index rows for an agent-deleted record

blind_spots: mixed expired/pending batch behavior was not exercised
sensitive-record deletion and protection-codec behavior were not probed
no production consolidation caller or evals-runner second engine was traced end to end
no multi-process maintenance, long-lived growth, or real provider run was used
coordinator_flags: CF10 direct review completed without subagent delegation per owner request
the F19 deleted:false mechanism is refuted; the missing worker caller is the surviving boundary defect
CF10-OBS-01 receipt lead is a duplicate of F19 deletion-receipt findings and is excluded from counts
